system.description: The draugr can take the form of a chosen animal, often a wolf, raven, or horse, and gains its physical characteristics; its HP are not preserved. The transformation takes three turns, during which it cannot defend itself. Each change from one form to another costs 30 days and nights.
system.summary: Allows a draugr to take an animal form.
